consequence.statement: An exposed environment whose operator does nothing is unaffected: the removed-values list is empty, so no previously accepted spec.chartRef.kind value is rejected; the previously invalid value ExternalArtifact simply becomes accepted.

original.statement: In the helm.toolkit.fluxcd.io/v2 HelmRelease schema, the enum of spec.chartRef.kind gained the allowed value ExternalArtifact (computed artifact diff between the v2.6.4 and v2.7.0 install bundles), with no values removed.

decision.reason: The computed diff between the v2.6.4 [ev-782bc47d120d] and v2.7.0 [ev-c2c6c790d6b2] install bundles reports spec.chartRef.kind as removed [], added ["ExternalArtifact"]. The enum was only widened, so no value that was accepted before is now rejected, and an environment that does nothing is unaffected (none, informational). P2's reading of "removed []" as removing an empty value is wrong. The validator that reports the enum as unchanged also shows no removed value. Confidence is low because the excerpts themselves only show "apiVersion: v1".
